name: workpath-author-local
description: Local-first visual authoring for accessible Moodle Books, with portable Windows delivery and ZIP/MBZ recovery.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @workpath/core && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @workpath/server" "npm run dev -w @workpath/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @workpath/core && npm run build -w @workpath/web && npm run build -w @workpath/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @workpath/core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test -w @workpath/core && npm run test -w @workpath/server
